name: 49204-mixedlongprompt-4b-4gpudp
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 on ONE node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90, NVLink between the four cards. Driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: DP=4, TP=1, PP=1 -- four whole replicas, one per GPU, behind one front end using the engine's own internal load balancing; no external router. The width is part of the setup and may not be reduced.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bound 1024 requests, safety cap 2400 s, warmup the first 10%, no cooldown, static seed 49204.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), no prefix buckets. Prompt length is a uniform integer draw over [2048, 30720] tokens (mean 16384); output is exactly 1024 tokens for every request, held there by `ignore_eos`. A pass is 1024 requests: ~16.8M prompt tokens in, 1048576 out.
purpose: A long-document analysis service on a 4-billion-parameter model, serving 64 concurrent readers across four GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: a source checkout of dbccc5ae328d7b9168bc33b278a9125cfd89cc69
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.23.1rc0-1558-gdbccc5ae328d), named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B

# Four data-parallel replicas, one per GPU of one node; no tensor split.
# `data-parallel-size-local` and `data-parallel-rank-local` are left unset on purpose: that is the
# online path -- one front end, four spawned engine processes, no external router.
data-parallel-size: 4
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Worst case is 30720 prompt + 1024 output = 31744 tokens.
max-model-len: 32768

# PINNED, LOAD-BEARING -- do not delete either as "the default". At this commit the batch defaults
# come from a per-usage-context table that an in-process engine may not reach, and the fallback
# 2048 / 256 chunks these long prompts far finer and admits far fewer per step.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# The checkpoint's own dtype and vLLM's own default, written out so a change of default cannot
# move the activation width or the KV pool between runs.
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
